# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of `@supabase/supabase-js` **2.117.2**, downloaded from npm and included under its MIT license (`SUPABASE-LICENSE.txt`). It is served from the same origin; there is no runtime CDN dependency. To reproduce it, run `npm ci` then `npm run vendor`. The lockfile pins all packages. PGlite is development-only and never loaded in the browser.
